notes.title: ARE YOU READY FOR THIS?
notes.notes:
To the attention of all the doomed who are not lucky enough to get on this page!
Very soon, literally from day to day, something that no one expected will be released, namely, the EXPENSIVE game for BeeTights, Tap-Tap Adventure!
SUCH a joyful event is akin to the birth of the first child, well, we can only hope that this child does not go into his pants, but will walk his way from birth to oblivion with dignity!
INSANELY grateful to all those who decide to invest their money in this indecency, which for some reason was called a game.
If you are reading this text, smile, because BeeTights think that you are charming :3
